about: A manager for torrent trackers and Usenet indexers that feeds them to apps like Sonarr and Radarr.

prs.title: API keys stay out of the logs
prs.broken: When an app rejected a sync, the error it sent back was logged with its API key in plain sight.
prs.changed: The log cleaner now also spots keys in that escaped form and hides them.
prs.matters: Logs people share for help no longer leak the keys to their apps.
